01 · PUBLIC CONTEXT & INTELLIGENCE
Evidence with a source.

Explore reported events and reference geography, inspect original evidence and review imagery analysis before turning it into an assessment.

USGS and FIRMS event reports with provenance and history
Satellite imagery comparison and analyst review
External tracks, station weather and official hazard reports
Versioned geographic packages for simulation authoring

Public workspace available

Open Public Context →
02 · 3D MODELING & SIMULATION
A scene you can exercise.

Register 3D models, place actors in a georeferenced scene, freeze a scenario version and examine the observations generated by its runtime.

3D asset registry and georeferenced scene authoring
Abstract actor behavior and synthetic sensor presets
Native runtime and a separate Exercise COP
Recorded output, replay and after-action reports
